name: Josou Yuriarashi
source:
After the whirlwind romance between Iori and Mikage came to an end, the all trap school Ayanohara Academy found itself swept up in a full-blown love boom.

At the center of it all was Reona, the academy's “prince” figure, who is adored by all the "he-iresses" in school. Confessions of love came to him in droves… only for him to rejected them one after another, and leave a trail of heartbreak in his wake. As a result, now student council president, Iori spends her days desperately trying to contain the chaos Reona has unintentially caused.

Seeing this, Asuka proposes a drastic solution: Force Reona to take a lover in an attempt to bring the school's confession craze to an end.

And the one chosen for that role…is Mahiro, the academy’s only rude and crude delinquent trap.

Mahiro, who openly claims no interest in cross-dressing...paired with Reona, who has rejected every confession thrown his way...

Which of them will fall in love first!?
Once again, a bouquet of synthetic roses dressed in yuri begins has begun to bloom!

*But this time, everyone's favorite “prince” will be changing… into a princess!

[From the [url=https://no-strike.jp/yuriarashi/en/story.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
在伊织与御影那场轰轰烈烈的恋情落下帷幕之后，全员皆为伪娘的“绫野原学园”掀起了一股席卷全校的恋爱狂潮。

处于风暴正中心的，正是深受全校所有“伪娘千金”倾慕、宛如学园“白马王子”般的存在——礼央奈。向他表白心意的追求者络绎不绝……却被他一个接一个无情回绝，在身后留下了一地心碎。受此牵连，如今担任学生会长的伊织每天都忙得焦头烂额，拼命收拾礼央奈无意间捅出的烂摊子。

见此情形，明日香提出了一剂猛药：强行给礼央奈安排一位恋人，借此平息全校失控的告白狂潮。

而被选中担此重任的人选……竟是全校唯一一个言行粗鲁野蛮的不良伪娘真寻。

公然宣称对女装毫无兴趣的真寻……搭档来者不拒统统发卡的万人迷礼央奈……

两人之中究竟谁会先一步坠入爱河！？
披着百合外衣的人造蔷薇花束，即将再度绚烂绽放！

※只不过这一次，大家最心爱的“王子殿下”即将摇身一变……成为娇羞的公主！

[摘自[url=https://no-strike.jp/yuriarashi/en/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
